## LEDGER

**(a) Obligations**

**OB-1 — VIOLATOR: "fading trail from a presentation pointer keeps animating after the page changes"** — **CLOSED**
- closers: `packages/editor/src/lib/editor/managers/ScribbleManager/ScribbleManager.ts` (tldraw)
- Verbatim grounding: the internal `Session` interface (lines 48–56) holds `id, items, state, options, idleTimeoutHandle, fadeElapsed, totalPointsAtFadeStart` — **no page id**. `startSession` (74–99) never records the current page; `this.sessions` is a `Map` on a manager constructed once per `Editor` (line 62). `stopSession`/`clearSession`/`complete` (204–310) are all keyed by session id only. Nothing in the file reads the current page — confirmed by bulk_search: ScribbleManager is in the `noMatch` list for `CurrentPageId`.

**OB-2 — OWNER: "transient status of an in-flight fetch, reset when the key it belongs to changes"** — **CLOSED**
- closers: `packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts` (query) — `setOptions` (138–220) rebinds the observed query on option/key change and `getOptimisticResult` (222–250) exists specifically "to maintain reference consistency across query key changes"; `packages/db/src/query/live/collection-subscriber.ts` (db) — owns in-flight ordered-load tracking, `loadingPromise` and `sentValues`, and `loadMoreIfNeeded` (266–287) "resets internal tracking state on truncate events to prevent stale data". These are the contract ScribbleManager must be brought in line with.

**OB-3 — OWNER: "a pending selection / scope-bound state reset when the scope changes"** — **CLOSED**
- closers: `packages/editor/src/lib/editor/managers/SpatialIndexManager/SpatialIndexManager.ts` and `packages/editor/src/lib/editor/managers/CollaboratorsManager/CollaboratorsManager.ts` — the in-repo siblings in the same folder that **do** get it right (3 and 4 verbatim `CurrentPageId` matches respectively); `packages/editor/src/lib/editor/managers/SnapManager/SnapManager.ts` (1 match) is page-aware in shape discovery while still owning ephemeral snap indicators.

**OB-4 — OWNER: "an interaction still in progress, torn down when its owner changes"** — **OPEN**
- No file read to verdict. `ClickManager`, `EdgeScrollManager`, `InputsManager`, `FocusManager`, `HistoryManager`, `TickManager` are all in the `noMatch` list for `CurrentPageId` — page-blind like ScribbleManager — but I did not read their source, so they stay CANDIDATES, not rulings.

**(b) SWEEP MATRIX** — three rows are short; STEP 3.5 did **not** hold.

| OB-1 | 6 | tldraw, xyflow, primitives, react, redux-devtools, zustand | complete (6/6) |
| OB-2 | 7 | query, db, redux-toolkit, router, jotai, react-redux | **short — table not swept with OB-2's phrase** |
| OB-3 | 6 | table, tldraw (call refused at cap) | **short — xyflow, primitives, router, db not swept with OB-3's phrase** |
| OB-4 | 9 | redux, reselect, zod | **short — primitives, xyflow, tldraw, react, redux-devtools, react-redux not swept with OB-4's phrase** |

Cause: `stakeout` hit its per-run cap ("17 of 17 calls") after every one of the 16 repositories had been touched at least once. Per STEP 3.6 I switched to `collateral_damage`, `case_file`, `the_receipts` and `manhunt` rather than stopping; the un-swept pairs are declared rather than silently dropped. Nothing was ruled out on the strength of a missing sweep — every retrieved file stays in the list below.
